args: In src/in_dxf.c, analyze new_object's handling of DXF group code 310 and the common entity preview field. Identify the exact generic-field branch that aliases pair->value.s into entity->preview, explain the special add_ent_preview path and pair ownership, and recommend the smallest root-cause fix that preserves valid preview parsing while ensuring every code-310 pair outside the valid preview state cannot reach the generic dynapi setter.

The supplied ASan report shows a POINTCLOUD parsed in BLOCKS receives group code 310 while the subclass is not exactly AcDbEntity. The special preview branch is skipped, then common-field lookup finds malloc-owned TF field preview and dwg_dynapi_common_set_value copies the pair-owned pointer. new_object later invokes dxf_free_pair around line 12032, and dwg_free_common_entity_data frees the dangling preview pointer. I am considering intercepting code 310 for all entities before generic common-field lookup: valid AcDbEntity preview chunks should still call add_ent_preview, while invalid/out-of-state chunks should be ignored/rejected and then normally pair-freed. Please inspect relevant control flow and any implications such as subclass matching, preview_size, fixedtype, and whether code 310 has legitimate non-preview meanings in object-specific parsing.
